note: A template RECORD's numeric base operand followed by the ABBREVIATED ,INCR (or ,DECR) modifier is honored, so field offsets start at the base. asm.py _dir_record previously matched only the full words increment/decrement, so `StackFrame RECORD 1,INCR` (VideoKeyboard Key.a) left the base as `1,INCR`, evaluate() failed, base fell to 0, and every StackFrame field offset (and the derived _localSize) came out one low. Expected: a=1, b=3 (dc.w -> 0100 0300).
